record.name: Russia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Law 243-FZ (26 Jul 2026) makes national or sovereign status for large models conditional on a government-run compliance check against Russian law and traditional values; draft by-laws discussed in August 2026 would have accredited labs run the checks. This is a compliance check for a voluntary status, not a safety-evaluation institute.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Digital Development: draft model-check scheme
related_bodies.role: According to a single press source, the draft provides for accredited-lab checks of models seeking national or sovereign status under Law 243-FZ, for legal and values compliance, and by-laws were still in inter-agency agreement as of August 2026.

next_check.reason: Whether the draft by-laws on checking national models are adopted.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches did not establish a national AI safety institute. The existing legal and reporting evidence describes checks for national/sovereign model status and compliance with Russian law and values. No retrieved evidence expands those conformity checks into a government-designated evaluator of advanced models for capabilities and severe risks. The English pass adds search coverage, not a full re-review of the law. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Re-ran searches in English and Russian for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified. A February 2026 trade-press report of a planned ministry test site for AI security certification, which the ministry said it was not legislating, concerns conformity of deployed systems. Retrieved the presidential decree as new primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Russian, with the official publication card for Government decree 1461 of 6 November and a legal-text mirror of it. Left for review: decree 1461 of 6 November, which gives the digital development ministry powers to analyse foundation-model development, with the mirror reporting entry into force on 14 November. It names no model-testing body and no link to the six announced implementing decrees was found in the material read, whose adoption remains unverified. The ministry's news listing and the operative text on the official card could not be read. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded ru query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Russian; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: Presidential Decree No. 490, in the version of February 2024, approves the national AI strategy to 2030; the decree text names no body to evaluate advanced models.

record.notes: Government decree 1461 of 6 November 2026, in force from 14 November according to a legal-text copy, adds to the digital development ministry's powers the analysis of the development of large foundation AI models, including measures to improve their legal regulation, methodological support to state and local government bodies on them, and measures to encourage their development and use.
